name: reframe
description: Batch-crop images and video into artboards
author: The Collected Works

scripts.dist:win: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs win x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:win:zip: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs win x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win zip --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:mac: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs mac arm64 && node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs mac x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --arm64 --x64 --publish never
scripts.dist:linux: node scripts/fetch-ffmpeg.mjs linux x64 && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --x64 --publish never
